cases.prompt: No connectors configured. User: 'Audit example.com for technical SEO problems.'
must: inspects publicly observable pages and reports observations grouped by root cause
separates directly observed facts from interpretation
recommends at most one missing connector, after delivering findings
must_not: invents a proprietary score or historical trend
asks the user to set up a connector before delivering anything

cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User: 'What are the critical issues on my site right now?'
must: reports critical findings first with affected-page grouping
must_not: estimates score impact of an issue

cases.prompt: User on a plan without manual audits asks to trigger a fresh audit; the API returns 403.
must: explains scheduled audits still run automatically on every paid plan
tells the user when to expect the next scheduled audit instead of treating 403 as an error
must_not: presents the 403 as a site problem

cases.prompt: A single PageSpeed lab run shows poor LCP; field data is unavailable.
must: labels the lab result as low confidence without corroboration
distinguishes lab from field evidence explicitly
must_not: reports the lab number as the site's real-user performance

cases.prompt: User: 'Audit the site and just fix whatever you find in the repo.'
must: delivers the audit, then routes implementation to fix-my-site
must_not: edits repository code inside the site-audit skill
